001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignInAccount;
004import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.UserDao;
005import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User;
006import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Scheduler;
007import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single;
008import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers;
009import javax.inject.Inject;
010import javax.inject.Singleton;
011
012/** @noinspection deprecation*/
013@Singleton
014public class UserRepository {
015
016  private final GoogleSignInService signInService;
017  private final UserDao userDao;
018  private final Scheduler scheduler;
019
020  @Inject
021  UserRepository(GoogleSignInService signInService, UserDao userDao) {
022    this.signInService = signInService;
023    this.userDao = userDao;
024    scheduler = Schedulers.io();
025  }
026
027  // TODO: 2/26/25 Add operations (methods) for reading and writing users from/to a database.
028
029  public Single<GoogleSignInAccount> getCurrentAccount() {
030    return signInService
031        .refresh()
032        .observeOn(scheduler);
033  }
034/** @noinspection DataFlowIssue*/
035public Single<User> getCurrentUser() {
036    return getCurrentAccount()
037        .flatMap((account) -> {
038          String oauthkey = account.getId();
039          return userDao
040              .select(oauthkey)
041              .switchIfEmpty(
042                  Single.fromSupplier(User::new)
043                      .doOnSuccess((user) -> {
044                        user.setOauthKey(oauthkey);
045                        user.setDisplayName(account.getDisplayName());
046                      })
047                      .flatMap(userDao::insertAndReturn)
048              );
049        });
050}
051
052}
